name: Vasari Global (Vasari Beverages)
note: London-based private consumer investment group (47 Mount Street, London W1K 2SA). 'Vasari operates as a private multinational ... Founded by Samuel, and now led by Vivian and Jess Imerman' (vasariglobal.com/about, opened 2026-10-03). Vasari acquired KWV from Hosken Consolidated Investments in 2016 (kwv.co.za history); KWV announced in May 2024 it remains majority owned by Vasari Beverages, with Masimong Group and Rand Merchant Bank joining as minority shareholders (wine.co.za, 2024-05-07).
